title: Sleep
description: Protecting bedtime and wake time helps regulate mood, energy, and cycle rhythm.
benefit: Consistent sleep supports recovery and hormone balance.

title: Exercise
description: Movement can improve circulation, reduce stress, and support cycle comfort.
benefit: Regular movement supports stamina and confidence.

title: Stress
description: Notice tension early so stress does not quietly take over your day.
benefit: Stress regulation helps mood and focus stay steadier.

title: Meditation
description: Short mindfulness sessions can help reset the nervous system.
benefit: Meditation creates a pause that can reduce reactivity.

title: Daily Goals
description: Choose goals that are realistic for the energy you have today.
benefit: Small goals are easier to finish and repeat.

title: Self Care
description: Self-care works best when it is practical, not performative.
benefit: Simple care habits help you feel supported and restored.
goalText: Do one nourishing thing for yourself
